dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: It's said that you can see pretty far if you stand high, but the higher you go, the harder it is to see what's right beneath you...

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: Ah, sorry. I was talking to myself.

dialogues.speaker: Ashk
dialogues.text: If you're looking to join the Akademiya Extravaganza, then you probably got lost to wander this far. You're way past the boundaries of the festivities.
